definitions.explanation: Having excellent practical abilities, especially in business or professional contexts.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{敏腕|びんわん}な{経営者|けいえいしゃ}だ。
{敏腕|びんわん}プロデューサーとして{知|し}られている。
examples.english: He is known as a skilled producer.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{敏|びん} (quick, alert) + {腕|わん} (arm, skill) → quick-armed = capable

FORMS:
・{敏腕|びんわん}な{弁護士|べんごし} - capable lawyer
・{敏腕|びんわん}プロデューサー - skilled producer
・{敏腕|びんわん}を{振|ふ}るう - to demonstrate one's abilities

USAGE:
{敏腕|びんわん} is often used in business and professional contexts to describe someone who is highly effective at their job. It's more formal than {凄腕|すごうで} and implies professional competence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{敏腕|びんわん}{弁護士|べんごし} - capable lawyer
・{敏腕|びんわん}{経営者|けいえいしゃ} - capable manager
・{敏腕|びんわん}プロデューサー - skilled producer
・{敏腕|びんわん}エージェント - capable agent
